Hi Simon —

Looking forward to the hands-on POC workshop for Greenwave. A couple of logistics items to confirm so we can lock the room and access:

- Proposed time: Thursday May 28 or Friday May 29, 9:00 AM–1:00 PM PT. We recommend 4hrs for prompt review, routing walkthrough, and a short load test.
- Onsite vs virtual: we can run hybrid. If onsite, we need visitor names for building badges 48hrs prior. If virtual, we will send a Zoom link and request that participants mute video during the load test.
- Recording: we typically record demo segments for internal QA and follow-up notes. Please let us know if you have any recording restrictions. We can also mark sections as not recorded (e.g., contract/legal Q&A).
- AV & adapters: we'll bring an HDMI adapter and remote to switch demo machines, but let us know if the room has special AV.
- Attachments: draft agenda + visitor badge instructions attached.

Next steps: confirm preferred date (May 28 or May 29), whether you'll be onsite or remote, and the list of attendees for badges. Once confirmed, Marissa (cc'd) will book the room and Connor will coordinate the load-test window and routing profile.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.com | M: +1 (415) 555-0186
